pages.text: $(#555)$(o)(3D scene not available in this version)$()$(br2)Monitors allow visualization and interaction with a single item or fluid type, without opening a GUI.$(br2)Monitors will inherit the color of the $(l:items_blocks_machines/cables)cable$(/l) they are mounted on.$(br2)If the monitor is on the floor or ceiling, you can rotate it
with a $(l:items_blocks_machines/wrench)Certus Quartz Wrench$(/l).$(br2)They are $(l:ae2_mechanics/cable_subparts)cable subparts$(/l).

pages.title: Storage Monitor
pages.text: Will show an item or fluid and its quantity. Put them next to your farms or something...$(br2)Does $(o)not$() require a $(l:ae2_mechanics/channels)channel$(/l).$(br2)Keybinds:$(li)Right-click with an item or double-right-click with a fluid container to set the monitor to that item/fluid.$(li)Right-click with an empty hand to clear the monitor.$(li)Shift-right-click with an empty hand to lock the monitor.

pages.title: Conversion Monitor
pages.text: The Conversion Monitor is similar to a storage monitor, but allows you to insert or extract its configured item.$(br2)If the configured item is $(l:ae2_mechanics/autocrafting)autocraftable$(/l) and none are in storage, attemping to take an item will instead open a UI to specify the amount to be crafted.$(br2)$(o)Does$() require a $(l:ae2_mechanics/channels)channel$(/l).$(br2)Additional keybinds:

$(li)Left-click to extract a stack of the configured item, or request craft of that item if none are in storage.$(li)Right-click with any item to insert that item.$(li)Right-click with an empty hand to insert all of the configured item from your inventory.
